verdict.element_note: On the element split NOTHING approaches 0.82 -- including the baseline (0.26-0.50). The bar was mis-specified for that split: 0.82 is a COMBINATION-level in-sample number and does not transfer to predicting an unseen element.
verdict.identity_model_headline: An IDENTITY-based learned model's entire advantage is INTERACTION CAPTURE among elements it has already seen. Given an unseen promoter it is WORSE than the additive baseline and below chance (-0.014): it learned identity, not sequence.

sequence_verdict.headline: Scoring a NOVEL RBS from its letters works: sequence features lift a never-seen RBS well above both the additive baseline and the identity model. The promoter_only control shows the promoter alone does not account for it.
